childReport.diffSummary: Reviewed the test architecture of the plan-007 QML improvement pass: 38-function Qt Quick Test harness over real component sources with fake bridges, qmllint gate, and extended bridge unit tests. The harness is real and caught 3 product bugs, but several pins are weaker than claimed: the PoseCell capture-tuple test mutates state after the synchronous commit (cannot detect the C2 regression), the dataset-swap test never simulates the transient it guards, and the plan's U6 composition-root scenarios (load ordering, replace-confirm, run-close, discard reopen, toolbar Camera/Model run-lock) were never delivered. The 0-keypoint heatmap guard and the D-08 toggle re-asserts are unpinned; fake fidelity has gaps (accepts 'inf', no range checks). The D3/D4 unit pins (table refresh owner, ML-seed invalidation) are genuinely strong.
